import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/deps')
import zstandard as zstd, io, random
# build a frame with checksum, skippable frames, concatenated frames
cctx=zstd.ZstdCompressor(write_checksum=True, write_content_size=True)
data=b'hello world '*100
f1=cctx.compress(data)
f2=cctx.compress(b'abc')
skip=b'\x50\x2a\x4d\x18'+(8).to_bytes(4,'little')+b'12345678'
payload=skip+f1+f2
dr=zstd.ZstdDecompressor().stream_reader(io.BytesIO(payload), read_across_frames=True)
